description.summary: glass regions computed by the compositor

protocol.description: A client declares regions of one of its surfaces to be rendered as glass: the compositor samples what is behind the surface and shows it blurred, with the color and refraction of the chosen material. The client draws its own content (text, icons) on top, with transparent pixels where the glass must show.

destroys the manager; glass objects stay valid

request.name: get_glass

description.summary: glass object for a surface

request.description: A surface has at most one glass object: a second get_glass on the same surface is the already_has_glass error.

interface.name: silica_glass_v1

description.summary: glass regions of a surface

interface.description: The state is double-buffered: clear and add_region change the pending state, which becomes current on the next wl_surface.commit. Coordinates are in the surface coordinate system, in logical pixels. Since version 8 a region can be rotated about its centre (set_rotation): its x, y, width and height are then the rectangle before the rotation.

description.summary: removes the glass from the surface on the next commit

enum.name: material

description.summary: measured materials

enum.description: The measured glass families: clear (small blur, almost transparent), thick (wide blur, almost white in the light appearance) and regular (the lens glass of controls: strong lens at the edge). Since version 2: notification (very wide blur, almost opaque, like banners and the Notification Center).

description.summary: the kind of surface a glass belongs to

enum.description: The compositor picks the blur, the refraction (strength and how far it reaches from the edge), the edge light, the tint and saturation and the shadow of each kind, and its tone (what the background becomes behind it). default: the kind follows from the material (clear: dock, thick: menu, regular: module, notification: banner).

description.summary: removes all pending regions

request.name: add_region

description.summary: adds a region to the pending state

request.description: A rectangle with circular-arc corners of the given radius (0 = square corners).

request.name: add_translucent_region

description.summary: adds a region with an opacity

request.description: Like add_region, with the glass composed at the given opacity (0–1): a panel that fades in or out carries its glass with it.

request.name: separate

description.summary: the following regions form a group of their own

request.description: Regions added after this request do not merge with those added before, even when close or overlapping, and are drawn on top of them: a submenu over its menu. clear goes back to the first group.

request.name: add_continuous_region

description.summary: adds a region with continuous corners

request.description: Like add_translucent_region, with the corners drawn as a continuous curve instead of a circular arc (the shape of an app icon's body). `radius` is the radius of the equivalent circular corner, `smoothing` (0–1) how far the curve spreads along the edges: the corner starts radius × (1 + smoothing) from the corner point along each edge. With a smoothing of 0 it is a circular corner. The compositor draws a superellipse fitted to the Sketch body path (radius 214 and smoothing 0.6 on 824) within 0.5 px at 60 and 128 pt. Applies with set_rotation like the other regions.

request.name: add_tip

description.summary: adds a downward tip

request.description: A tip in the given rectangle, the base on the top side (the body's edge) and the round apex at the middle of the bottom side: concave fillets leave the body edge at the rectangle's left and right sides, turn into straight flanks and meet in the apex. The compositor draws the measured outline closest to the rectangle's size (a Dock menu's tip is 31 × 10, a popover's 32 × 11, a sideways popover's 39 × 12). It merges with the regions of the same group and material: the glass edge runs without a break from the body to the tip.

request.name: add_upward_tip

description.summary: adds an upward tip

request.description: Like add_tip, flipped: the base on the bottom side of the rectangle and the apex at the middle of the top side (a popover below the button that opens it).

request.name: add_side_tip

description.summary: adds a tip pointing left or right

request.description: Like add_tip, turned sideways: pointing left, the base on the right side of the rectangle and the apex at the middle of the left side; pointing right, the other way round (a popover beside the control that opens it). The base is the rectangle's height, the depth its width.

request.name: set_profile

description.summary: the profile of the following regions

request.description: The regions added after this request belong to this kind of surface, until the next set_profile or clear (which goes back to default and client). With compositor, the compositor draws the profile's shadow under the glass, outside its shape; the client then draws none. Pending state like the regions.

request.name: set_rotation

description.summary: the rotation of the following regions

request.description: The regions and tips added after this request are rotated by this angle about the centre of their own rectangle, in degrees, clockwise on screen (the y axis points down), until the next set_rotation or clear (which goes back to 0). The whole shape turns with it: the corners, the edge light (on the region's own top edge), the outline, the lens and the compositor's shadow. A label tilted with its object declares its upright rectangle and the angle, not the bounding box of the tilted one. Pending state like the regions.
